LanguageData.WindowEquipCursedBladeDesc:
This sword is cursed with a malevolent spirit.

It feeds from the life force of any living beings killed by it and grants rewards to its user depending on how fed it is. However, if the wielder fails to nourish it for a long period of time, the sword will start draining the life force of the wielder until he meets his own demise.

Besides, the sword will not part ways with its wearer easily and might try to fight back if unequipped. The worst possible situation in this case would be the wielder experiencing a berserk mental break.

Are you sure you want to equip this sword ?
LanguageData.CursedSwordBerseker: The sword cursed its wearer into a temporary state of rage-inducing delirium.
LanguageData.FoxianModSettingsWarning: Changing any value might require a restart or reloading a save!
LanguageData.FoxianInformation: You can get more information about each setting by hovering your mouse over the labels.
LanguageData.PsychicManipulationSettingsDesc: This number means you gain a bonus skill point for every x% of psychic sensitivity beyond 100%. Each pawn has a base psychic sensitivity of 100% (unless they have traits or genes that change the default value).\nBy default, the threshold is 25%, so a pawn with 150% psychic sensitivity will gain 2 bonus social skill points.
LanguageData.PsychicManipulationSettingSkillsDropDown: The skill shown on the button will receive the bonus skill points from the gene.
LanguageData.AnimalConnectionSettingsDesc: This threshold represents how much psychic sensitivity a pawn needs to trigger the "Animal Connection" effect. By default, the value is set to 150%. Setting the value to 0% will disable the trigger.
LanguageData.GeneticPurityFoxianTrigger: Must a person be a Foxian to trigger the first behavior of the genetic purity gene?
LanguageData.GeneticPurityFoxianTriggerDesc: By default, only a Foxian or a person considered "Foxian enough" can give birth to an offspring with xenotype A or B. Otherwise, they will pass all their genes on to the offspring. If you disable this condition, anyone with this gene will be able to give birth to xenotype A or B, whether they are Foxian or not.
LanguageData.GeneticPuritySettingXenotypeADesc: The xenotype shown on the button will be used for offspring with xenotype A. By default, xenotype A is set to the Foxian xenotype.
LanguageData.GeneticPuritySettingXenotypeBDesc: The xenotype shown on the button will be used for offspring with xenotype B. By default, xenotype B is set to the Greater Foxian xenotype.
LanguageData.GeneticPurityXenotypeAChanceSlider: Chance for offspring to be xenotype A
LanguageData.GeneticPurityXenotypeAChanceSliderDesc: By default, the offspring has a 70% chance of being born as xenotype A. If the value is set to 0%, the offspring will always be born as xenotype B. If set to 100%, the offspring will always be born as xenotype A.
LanguageData.GeneticPurityXenotypeMaleChanceSlider: Chance for an offspring to be male (xenotype B)
LanguageData.GeneticPurityXenotypeMaleChanceSliderDes: By default, when the offspring is born with xenotype B, it has a 70% chance of being male. If this value is set to 0%, the offspring will always be female. If set to 100%, the offspring will always be male when born with xenotype B.
LanguageData.GeneticPurityXenotypeFemaleChanceSliderA: Chance for an offspring to be female (when the mother is not a Foxian)

By default, when the mother is not a Foxian, the offspring has an 80% chance of being female. If this value is set to 0%, the offspring will always be male. If set to 100%, the offspring will always be female.\nPlease note that this modifier does nothing if the "Must a person be a Foxian to trigger the first behavior of the genetic purity gene?" option has been disabled.
LanguageData.maxProgressTreeMultiplierSlider: Multiplier for the amount of meditation needed to trigger a blessing
LanguageData.maxProgressTreeMultiplierSliderDesc: Changes how long you need to meditate to trigger a blessing. Lower values shorten the time needed, while higher values lengthen it.
LanguageData.IsFoxianBi: Does the Lustful gene force the Bisexual trait?
LanguageData.IsFoxianBiDesc: The title is self-explanatory. Simply removes/adds the forced trait to the gene (a restart is required).
LanguageData.FoxianTailAgeInfo: Please be cautious when changing the values below.\nThe values must be in ascending order, as shown below.\nA restart is required.
LanguageData.FoxianOneTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets one tail (recommended: 0).
LanguageData.FoxianThreeTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets three tails (recommended: 3).
LanguageData.FoxianFiveTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets five tails.
LanguageData.FoxianSevenTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets seven tails.
LanguageData.FoxianNineTailAgeDesc: Set the age at which the pawn gets nine tails.
LanguageData.FoxianMedievalModeDesc: This option transforms the two Foxian factions into medieval factions centered around melee. This is not a patch for the Medieval Overhaul mod, since one is already included automatically. It is simply an option for players seeking a vanilla medieval run.\nA restart is required.
LanguageData.FoxianModWarningText:
This warning will only appear once.
If you just started a new save, you can disregard this warning.

The mod has recently received a big update. Many new features have been added, and older ones have been reworked.
As a result, some things from older save files might not work correctly anymore. The most likely culprits are the psychic channeling and protection genes.

However, this does not mean you need to start a new save. On the mod's Workshop page, you can find a link to a downloadable archive of the old version, so you can continue playing your current save without any issues. Alternatively, you can copy the same link to the clipboard with the button below.
Once on the GitHub page, click the "Code" button and then "Download ZIP". Finally, install the old version manually as a separate mod.
LanguageData.FoxianModWarningAccept: I've read the warning and am aware of the potential repercussions if I don't take the necessary precautions
